x: Our thanks are indeed due to our Social Secretary, "Dave," for the splendid evening he put on for us. The dance following was very ably conducted by Bert Ellsey.

During the course of the evening it was announced that Len Herbert had been awarded the Sir Harry Barclay Cup by the Surrey County A.A. for the best performance of 1949. The dance which followed dinner was very ably conducted by Bert Ellsey and our thanks are due to “ Dave ” for a very splendid evening.
However, the excellent work of Bert Ellsey as M.C. really got things going and we all went away feeling that we had enjoyed another good "Belgrave Night."
